Three.js local vendor files
===========================

Classic script version: 0.128.0

Files used by the demo through normal `<script src="...">` tags:

- `classic/three.min.js`
- `classic/controls/OrbitControls.js`

The older ES module files are kept in `build/` and `examples/jsm/` only as a
reference copy. `index.html` does not load them.
